unresolved_ambiguities: The source reports siMicu1-LNPs as ApoE-associated for liver targeting, but does not provide the preparation details or quantitative incorporation evidence for ApoE; it is retained as a reported targeting-ligand association only.
The source establishes liver as the primary target organ after FITC-labeled siMicu1-LNP administration, but it does not establish direct delivery of the LNPs to LSECs.

Figure 7 formulation characterization, biodistribution, and therapeutic-outcome studies are retained within the approved E04 boundary, although the clauses do not conclusively establish that all subprocedures used the same animal cohort.
